description: §66.3 rule 5 (g): `count()` declares no return type and is recursive — a function whose proof needs its own return is not proven — so `<v=(count(3))/>` is E-DECL-TYPE-NOT-INFERABLE.
rationale: §66.3 rule 5: "A function whose proof needs its own return (recursion, direct or through another function or cell) is not proven"; rule 7: a call whose return is neither declared nor proven is outside the set. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §7 item 1: "calls to functions with a declared or inferred-and-proven return").
